108254765143672.title: Midnight Gryphon
108254765143672.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Shrouded in shadow and silence, the Midnight Gryphon glides through the darkness like a secret given form. Its wings, vast and velvet-black, drink the light from stars and lanterns alike, leaving only a whisper in its wake. The sleek muscles of its lion?s frame move with spectral grace, while its eyes gleam with a pale, cold fire that sees beyond illusion. Born beneath eclipsed moons and tempered in the hush of forgotten hours, the Midnight Gryphon is not merely a mount but a myth wrapped in feather and claw. It serves only the Mayor of Winstead, whose command must be as quiet as it is absolute, and whose presence must be felt even when unseen.

108367665124984.title: Drake of the Canopy
108367665124984.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
1000% Maximum Health
more: Majestic yet elusive, the Drake of the Canopy is the official mount of Joeva?s Mayor, an honor bestowed upon only the most commanding figure in the region. Native to the lush woodlands of Verra, this regal creature has evolved to blend seamlessly into the treetop canopy with its foliage-mimicking scales. Though it moves with silent grace, it commands fear and respect as one of the forest?s most formidable ambush predators. As a symbol of leadership and primal cunning, the Drake of the Canopy embodies the spirit of Joeva itself.

6064630010924367875.title: Rose Gryphon
6064630010924367875.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Bathed in the blush of dawn and crowned in petals of gilded crimson, the Rose Gryphon soars as the resplendent guardian of Winstead?s verdant vales and flowering highlands. A rare and radiant kin of the storied Gryphon line, it bears the sinewed might of a lion entwined with the luminous grace of a rose-hued eagle. Its wings shimmer with iridescent hues, catching the light like stained glass in a cathedral of wind and bloom. The Rose Gryphon is a symbol not only of courage and command but of beauty in defiance, strength rooted in elegance. It answers to no rider save the Mayor of Winstead, whose sovereignty is woven with the same paradox the creature embodies: fierce gentility, and a will that blooms even in blood-soaked soil.

6064630016173473793.title: The Sandals of Holding
6064630016173473793.description: Looks like you could hold a bunch of sandals in these sandals.

6064630140772614274.title: Apprentice Tailor's Pants
6064630140772614274.description: Finely stitched pants worn by those who serve the seam between utility and artistry. Often unnoticed beneath the folds of a tunic, leggings hold the first tension of thread and form for a new apprentice.

6064630140779888774.title: Novice Leatherworker's Shirt
6064630140779888774.description: This stiff, thick-woven shirt bears the scent of smoke, salt, and the slow-burning acid of the tannery vat. Its sleeves are rolled high not for style, but to keep fresh-cut leather from soaking through.

6064630141165043875.title: Apprentice Stonemason's Skivvies
6064630141165043875.description: A foundational garment cut for those who shape the bones of the world. Forged in dust and muscle, they are less a comfort and more a quiet contract with the stone.

6064630141166092452.title: Novice Stonemason's Shirt
6064630141166092452.description: A weighty, dust-thirsty garment worn by those who carve form from silence. It's not clean, it's not elegant--but it endures, just like the stone it serves.

6064630141189226671.title: Journeyman Lumber Miller's Tool Belt
6064630141189226671.description: Tooled from darkened pinehide and reinforced with copper rivets, this belt holds square, wedge, scriber, and chalk like it was born to do so.

6064630169027805260.title: The Bull Ring
6064630169027805260.description: A crude iron ring, much larger than those for the ear. It is warm to the touch, almost searing skin.

6064630366692311224.title: Brooksteel Mace
6064630366692311224.description: Weighted to follow through, the Brooksteel Mace lands with a thud that echoes strangely in damp air. It leaves a faint shimmer where it strikes, like light caught beneath water.

more: Clad in bronze scales that shimmer like sunlit armor, the Wyrmling is the ember-born offspring of a militant legacy. Though small in stature, it carries the spirit of an ancient fire, coiled tight within a frame still learning its place in the skies. Its breath is smoke and promise, its eyes twin coals that burn with challenge and curiosity. Tempered by flame and ferocity, it yields to no hand that has not earned its trust through trial. Once bound, however, its loyalty is fierce and unshakable, a bond forged not by dominance, but by mutual will. The Mayor of Halcyon holds that bond, rising into the storm-laced heavens astride a creature that may yet grow into legend.

6064631121052041252.title: Horse
more: Sinew and spirit in perfect rhythm, the Horse has long been the companion of warriors, wanderers, and kings. Its hooves drum like distant thunder across plains and stone, carrying its rider with speed, grace, and silent resolve. Though lacking the horns or claws of more fearsome beasts, few mounts rival its endurance or loyalty. Muscles ripple beneath a coat of wind-washed hair, and eyes gleam with quiet intelligence, ever alert to threat and command alike. It is not shaped by magic, but by trust and time, and in that lies its power.

more: Cloaked in shimmerwoven aether and kissed by the first light of the celestial dawn, the Mayoral Dawnbreaker of New Aela is no ordinary flying mount. Its form, a sublime fusion of ancient magic and primal grace, defies natural order: the musculature of a great owlbear, the ringed tail of a dusk-born rakari, and the multicolored, translucent wings of a butterfly. It is a living sigil of authority, arcana, and awe.

6064632184249384971.title: Barrel of Clean Glass Sand
6064632184249384971.description:
Literally a cask full of sand though, in this case, that sand has been meticulously filtered so only the clearest grains remain.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Desert Spices

It is mostly contained full of various brightly colored ground powders, but it smells amazing!

This item can be delivered to the Citizen Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Glass Ingots

It's hard to tell the quality of the glass when its been cast into bricks like this, but there are no visible blemishes, which is notable.

This item can be delivered to the Settlement Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Sanctus Scrip.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Vaelune Poetry Codices

For collectors, these "rhyme books" from the desert's dueling poets are highly prized.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate  of Raw Shells

After they are harvested, the shells of local shellfish are often sold as materials for various crafts.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Raw Coral

Often when diving for shellfish, divers will retrieve broken off pieces of the local coral for use in carving and other crafts.

This item can be delivered to the Citizen Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.

6064632184293031951.title: Record of Sundra
6064632184293031951.description: "The Pool of Persea, that is what the myths call it. Said to be the baths of nobility, its now as toxic as Foul Grog. Its impurity seems to be connected to the bones the Goblins toss into it. But where does the water go?"

6064633267255771136.title: Horn of Firebrand
6064633267255771136.description: The Horn of Firebrand is crafted from the massive, spiraled horn of the great dragon Ignusis Firebrand. The surface has a lustrous, fiery sheen that shifts colors in sunlight - gleaming hues of crimson, gold, and deep orange wash the relic's surface, mimicking dancing flame. The horn's wide base tapers smoothly to a fine point.

6064633267275300866.title: Tumok's Totem
6064633267275300866.description: The fat bole of a Sujomman Bobe forms the heart of Tumok's Totem. Scraped and scarred by the vast distances, and unnumbered hardships that Tumok has faced since leaving his homelands, the hardy bobe-trunk remains sturdy and firm. Only a few short branches afford the attachment of fetishes and baubles, collected along Tumok's long travels.

6064633267288342532.title: Dusklit Revelation
6064633267288342532.description: The Dusklit Revelation is an ethereal construct of tightly interlocked crystals that once shimmered with vibrant hues even in dim light. Thin hairline cracks only slightly mar the otherwise pristine surface of the polyhedral form, it now emits a more subdued, spectral glow. Quiet, ghostlike imagery of merriment and laughter flickers forever within its facets, and light refracts oddly through the subtle cracks, creating haunting silhouettes that flicker eerily across any surrounding walls.

6064633271658020864.title: Bloodwrought Athames
6064633271658020864.description: Autumn at Carphin, spells clashed, twisting both caster and tool. Brass blades, once pure, wept crimson - tools of study turned to wicked ends. Now, those blades, still warped, crave blood, echoing the ancient touch of corruption.

6064633288742076416.title: Memento of Longing
6064633288742076416.description:
Drop: Captain Tharsus 
Ingredient In: Weaponsmithing
more: A tarnished silver locket, its gold trim worn. Inside, a naive oil portrait of a Kaelar maiden, her features slightly off, yet charmingly earnest. The paint is thick, the colors bold, capturing a youthful spirit.

6064633289002582028.title: Salt-stiffened Patchwork
more: A piece of fabric froSalt-crusted leather, stiff with dried sweat and flecked with dark stains. These scraps, once supple kidskin, now bear the map of countless brawls and voyages. Each salty spray, each drop of blood, each bead of sweat, layers into a hardened patina, a testament to brutal living on the high seas.m Historia.

6064633289003696148.title: Pyresteel Haft
6064633289003696148.description:
Drop: Zephras the Molten 
Ingredient In: Weaponsmithing
more: This incredibly durable haft was forged from rare Pyresteel. Its pitted surface and dark hue is evidence of the intense heat it endured during its forging.

6064633289550856237.title: Beastwarden's Prod
6064633289550856237.description: Cajoling an irascible beast into combat is a difficult enough burden when the animal is well cared for and comfortable; in more trying times, a prod may be necessary.

6064633289631531011.title: Scalerunner Beast Of Burden
6064633289631531011.description: A fine beast trained to pull caravans.

6064633289726230825.title: Cognocker Bracers
6064633289726230825.description: Eddis was a fanatical proponent of the exotic inventions of Olek Bellsong. Although he was a mere cogknocker, he believed his continued service would make him light warden someday.

6064633289754739037.title: Lungs of the Abyss
6064633289754739037.description: Sea giants are known for their ability to hold their breaths for long periods of time, but none greater than Mal'Rhos, the high priest of the Isle of Bones. His secret rests around his wrist, a strap of leather adorned with the magical gem, the Lungs of the Abyss.

6064633289759129974.title: Tidewarden's Compass
6064633289759129974.description: This relic once guided the Tidewarden's fleet through the Turquoise Sea. Unyielding to time, it never rusts or tarnishes, its needle forever seeking the artifact that doomed its captain.

6064633289798189458.title: The Infernal Fists
6064633289798189458.description: Deep in the fire elemental, Olek Bellsong snatched its heart. Only his arcane gauntlets kept him safe and allowed him to claim victory.

6064633289869754909.title: Belt of the Wolfguard
6064633289869754909.description: Beast taming knights within the order of Tura'Madu were granted the title of Wolfguard as a sign of their mastery of animal husbandry.

6064633306653851683.description:
Gather: Turquoise Sea, Jundark, Crucibles 
Ingredient In: Stonemasonry, Alchemy, Metalworking

6064633312408240160.title: Bird of Paradise Seed
6064633312408240160.description:
Gather: Turquoise Sea, Jundark 
Ingredient In: Farming
more: Bird of Paradise seed can be used to grow more Birds of Paradise.

6064633328376610857.title: Dried Plumeria Board
6064633328376610857.description:
Process: Lumber Milling 
Ingredient In: Carpentry, Weaponsmithing

6064633328378314795.title: Dried Dragon Tree Board
6064633328378314795.description:
Process: Lumber Milling 
Ingredient In: Arcane Engineering, Weaponsmithing, Carpentry

6064633334499639333.title: Dragon Tree Rooting Ball
6064633334499639333.description: This self-fertilizing root ball will grow a strong dragon tree when planted in a freehold.

6064633345976632437.title: TEST Freehold Deed
6064633345976632437.description: Right click this item to spawn a freehold test at the location.

6064633373920264192.title: Apprentice Hunting Trap
6064633373920264192.description: An iconic tool used solely by hunters.

6064633379918118948.title: Polished Bone
6064633379918118948.description: This piece of bone is smooth and polished, though weathered over time. One end is tapered to a fine point, perfect for crafting into a needle or an arrowhead.

6064633429429649427.title: Siege Declaration Banner - Tangled Post
6064633429429649427.description:
A level 15 or above player can use this banner to declare a siege against Tangled Post.

Seek out a stone platform near the marketplace of Tangled Post to place this banner.

6064633430590555284.title: Tideroller Nut
6064633430590555284.description:
Drop: Shanty Shawn 
Ingredient In: Arcane Engineering
more: With a sturdy shell patterned with cloudlike markings. The unique internal structure amplifies sound, making Tiderollers ideal for crafting drums with a deep, throaty resonance - prized by drummers across all of Verra.

6064633447505330184.title: Death Pearl
6064633447505330184.description: The Death Pearl thrums with whispers in a forgotten nautical tongue, guiding its wielder through fog, storm, and madness. When held aloft, it calls forth tendrils of abyssal magic, perfect for ensnaring souls or summoning horrors from the deep.

6064633453031981382.title: Keelhaul Tricorne
6064633453031981382.description: The infamous pirate king and military deserter, Keelhaul, once wore a Kaelar mariner captain's hat. It was his most treasured item until a former cohort and jilted love swiped it in revenge.

6064633527214276998.title: Sparkveil Bracers
6064633527214276998.description: Sit firm against the forearms, their edges catching stray sparks without slowing the hands they guard.

6064633618138860881.title: Mythbreak Siege Contract
6064633618138860881.description:
Purchase: Mythbreak Barracks 
Ingredient In: Tailoring

6064633765036359709.title: Vhalgadim Siege Contract
6064633765036359709.description:
Purchase: Vhalgadim Barracks 
Ingredient In: Tailoring

6064633776270147697.title: Staff of Hawkwyn
6064633776270147697.description: He would often transform into a falcon, guiding lost travelers through the Jundark.

6064633783356162262.title: Seething Thimble
6064633783356162262.description: A cold, lustrous cap forged of midnight alloy, its surface etched with spiraling runes that run around the circumference. Contoured for a precise fit, it carries a peculiar weight -? much too heavy for its size - and a faint prickle, as if it remembers blood and triumph. An aura of restraint clings to it, hinting at an unknown purpose.

6064633783595303127.title: Crumbling Shackle
6064633783595303127.description: These twisted bands are wrought from silver-black metal laced with faint glimmers of internal fire. Their delicate appearance belies a harsh rigidity, and hairline cracks spiderweb the surface, threatening to break with the right pressure. Touching them brings a dull ache, like frustration suppressed by bubbling rage.

6064633804185800752.title: Ramkin Gem
6064633804185800752.description: A gem recovered from the caverns inhabited by the Ramkin.

6064633855623626830.title: Resonite
6064633855623626830.description:
Gather: Anvils 
Ingredient In: Metalworking, Stonemasonry

6064633855777505418.title: Mourning Slate
6064633855777505418.description:
Gather: Anvils 
Ingredient In: Metalworking, Stonemasonry

6064633860907139093.title: Oathdelve Trousers
6064633860907139093.description: Those who wear them report hearing echoes of steps they did not take.

6064633860908187676.title: Tithebrook Vestment
6064633860908187676.description: Worn by those who kept record not with pen or seal, but with gesture and gaze.

6064633860915921043.title: Cindermarch Leggings
6064633860915921043.description: Cut to move easily over long marches, they give room for a sudden sprint or a low crouch without breaking stride.

6064633860917166252.title: Veilrender Cuisass
6064633860917166252.description: Panels overlapped and bound in a lattice meant to catch no light, the surface slick to the touch as though it has absorbed the breath of the forest.

6064633860917887161.title: Ferncloak Shoulders
6064633860917887161.description: Curve in a natural slope, their surface turning away a strike while keeping the frame low and mobile.

6064633860918411456.title: Slagwalker Greaves
6064633860918411456.description: Tall guards that carry the weight low, their finish dulled and roughened by the stone dust of the mountain paths.

6064633860918739143.title: Wavebound Breastplate
6064633860918739143.description: Plates shaped to the line of the torso, their surfaces marked with faint undulations that seem to swell and fade as light moves across them.

6064633860919066832.title: Dunecoil Jerkin
6064633860919066832.description: Balanced between guard and movement, its panels shift easily with the wearer's stride while turning aside the strike that comes without warning.

6064633860919525592.title: Gloomraider Cape
6064633860919525592.description: Falls in dark, heavy folds that break into tatters at the edge, its shape shifting with the stride like the shadows that spill from a storm-laden canopy.

6064633860919525600.title: Gloomraider Helm
6064633860919525600.description: Shadows the eyes beneath a broad curve, keeping the gaze clear in the half-light where the jungle meets the ruins.

6064633860920312036.title: Wildmarch Trousers
6064633860920312036.description: Cut for free stride, their weave breathes easily in the shade and holds its strength when drenched by stream or storm.

6064633860920312041.title: Wildmarch Hood
6064633860920312041.description: Drawn deep over the brow, it keeps the eyes shaded from sudden glare when the road breaks into open field.

6064633860920574189.title: Coalhewn Leggings
6064633860920574189.description: Move with the body through climbing, marching, and the swift turn of combat, never pulling against the stride.

6064633860920901883.title: Tidepiercer Helm
6064633860920901883.description: Low-crowned with a forward-swept brow, its crest recalling the sharp cut of a prow cleaving the swells.

6064633860921229567.title: Scorchmantle Greaves
6064633860921229567.description: Slim at the knee yet broad at the shin, catching the sand's bite without slowing the steady pace of the desert-born.

6064633860947509549.title: Glenwarden Gauntlets
6064633860947509549.description: Carved with twisting vine motifs, these gauntlets seem to flex even when still. Their grip once held torches and trail-banners alike.

6064633860948164920.title: Undermarch Greaves
6064633860948164920.description: Their weight steadies the march, and their design balances force with form. Dust never clings long to their surfaces, as if the earth itself respects their duty.

6064633860950917453.title: Luminous Concord Backplate
6064633860950917453.description: Presses close between the shoulders, as if recalling burdens not yet lifted. Some say it resonates faintly in the presence of unspoken command.

6064633860971561302.title: Stormcanon Cape
6064633860971561302.description: Stained by salt and sun, this cape holds the memory of wind that has never touched land. It moves with the hush of distant currents and carries the weight of storms whispered through reef and root.

6064633860983685545.title: Brineplate Treads
6064633860983685545.description: Each step strikes with the patient certainty of waves upon rock, as though guided by unseen currents that steady the bearer's path through every trial.

6064633860983685547.title: Brineplate Gauntlet
6064633860983685547.description: Closes with the inevitability of the returning tide, granting the wearer's grasp the same unshakable claim as the ocean over its domain.

6064633860983947701.title: Sunbastion Helm
6064633860983947701.description: Shields the eyes from the blinding glare so the gaze beneath remains fixed on the horizon, unbroken by the shimmer of the heat.

6064633860986372579.title: Cryptward Greaves
6064633860986372579.description: Carry the resolve of the wardens who once stood at the threshold and barred the way, their strength drawn from the unyielding ground beneath.

6064633860987945470.title: Reefguard Greaves
6064633860987945470.description: Advance through shifting ground with the poise of a diver moving among currents, every step placed with purpose.

6064633860989321741.title: Tombplate Bracers
6064633860989321741.description: Lock around the forearms with the same implacable grip as the roots that bind the tomb doors, lending steadiness to every guard and strike.

6064633860989321743.title: Tombplate Helm
6064633860989321743.description: Shadows the gaze beneath a narrow visor, cutting through the murk so only the necessary path lies in sight.

6064633860997710357.title: Emberwake Mantle
6064633860997710357.description: Fitted for those who shouldered burdens not cast in metal, but in memory.

6064633860997710360.title: Emberwake Treads
6064633860997710360.description: Marks remain where ash once pooled. They do not wash out, nor are they meant to.

6064633860998300191.title: Thistlemaw Sash
6064633860998300191.description: Sometimes creaks when it shouldn't, but only where paths once were.

6064633860998562347.title: Runebreath Bindings
6064633860998562347.description: Coils with intent, as if to hold the breath of a vow never exhaled.

6064633860999086646.title: Ashwoke Shawl
6064633860999086646.description: Stained by soot and time, this charred wrap once billowed through halls dark with emberfall. Its threads stir when fire remembers its name.

6064633861010424489.title: Dustwhisper Bracers
6064633861010424489.description: Rest close to the forearms, offering just enough guard for a deflection without burdening the draw of a blade.

6064633861012062902.title: Thistledown Leggings
6064633861012062902.description: Flow easily through each movement, from a quiet crouch to a long stride over uneven ground.

6064633861012521675.title: Mistglean Chest
6064633861012521675.description: Cut close for ease and speed, its light weave moves with the body whether climbing rigging or darting through shallows.

6064633861012521677.title: Mistglean Forearms
6064633861012521677.description: Rest lightly at the forearms, shedding spray as easily as the crest of a wave slides from the bow.

6064633861012980444.title: Wraithskin Tassets
6064633861012980444.description: Binds the set in a seamless hold, its ends unmoving even when the wind stirs the leaves above.

6064633861012980446.title: Wraithskin Boots
6064633861012980446.description: Step without sound on sodden loam, their tread molding to the ground so not even the undergrowth stirs.

6064633861013832420.title: Brightgrove Shoulders
6064633861013832420.description: Sit light against the frame, shaped to turn aside stray branch or sudden strike without slowing the turn of the body.

6064633861014029035.title: Ashveil Hood
6064633861014029035.description: Draws low over the eyes, breaking the shine of the gaze and blending the face into the lines of the mountain.

6064633861014029040.title: Ashveil Boots
6064633861014029040.description: Step without sound on gravel or frost, the soles finding sure purchase whether on narrow ledges or in the loose scree below.

6064633861014029042.title: Ashveil Gauntlets
6064633861014029042.description: Flex easily around the fingers, built for a grip that can shift from bowstring to blade without pause.

6064633861014291188.title: Seawisp Hood
6064633861014291188.description: Draws forward to soften the wearer's outline, blending face and shadow until they are no more than a shape in the sea-haze.

6064633861014553341.title: Duneflare Hood
6064633861014553341.description: Shadows the face in a wide, low fall, turning the sun's glare into a softened glow that leaves the eyes clear.

6064633861014881032.title: Nightwhisper Shoulders
6064633861014881032.description: Sit low and close to the body, shaped to slip through narrow gaps and turn aside a glancing blow.

6064633861171131742.title: Inscribed Ring
6064633861171131742.description: A ring of graystone found hidden along the Old King's Road.

sources.name: As you press the sequence, the pillar hums loudly. A hidden compartment slides open at its base, revealing a small, dust-covered coffer! The light from the runes then fades, and the gems are consumed by the pillar's energy. Opening the coffer reveals an inscribed ring that sends an unpleasant sensation down your fingertips when touched.

6064633866775035928.title: Cindertouched Earring
6064633866775035928.description: From the silent forges beneath Mount Dun, where no flame has burned since the Exodus, this earring still holds a single ember that never dims. Those who wear it hear sparks before they strike.

6064633866781982771.title: Driftwrought Ring
6064633866781982771.description: Its outer edge ripples with a tide worn texture, as if the sea itself shaped the band and left a trace of brine.

6064633866782703672.title: Scorchbound Ring
6064633866782703672.description: A sun kissed rim bears a faint halo of singe, and the face wavers with a mirage like hush in the brightest noon.

6064633866788274245.title: Wavetossed Ring
6064633866788274245.description: The outer edge rises and falls in a soft ripple, a breaker's crest held at the moment before it spills into foam.

6064633866903617615.title: Brooksteel Hatchet
6064633866903617615.description: Tempered by river-forging and cooled in the running shallows of the Larkrun, the Brooksteel Hatchet carries the subtle marks of its making as fine ripples across the blade that never rust, no matter the damp. It is said that the axe remembers the rhythm of the stream, and strikes truest when wielded without anger.

6064633895599669250.title: Mount Cosmetic: Obsidian Stallion
6064633895599669250.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Formed in the crucible of myth and shadow, the Obsidian Stallion gleams like polished volcanic glass. Its jet black hide shimmers with streaks of emberlight, and each step rings like hooves on stone. Forged for those who walk the line between destruction and discipline, it carries its rider with a quiet, ominous grace. Though bred for war, it does not bray or boast. It simply charges, calm and cataclysmic, through the heart of battle.

6064633895604125700.title: Mount Cosmetic: Spectral Mare
6064633895604125700.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Drifting between moonlight and shadow, the Spectral Mare glides with otherworldly grace. Hooves leave no prints, and its faint glow pulses like a memory half-forgotten. As a mount, it carries its rider as though across a dream, untouched by time or terrain.

6064633895616774159.title: Mount Cosmetic: Oathbearer
6064633895616774159.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Towering and solemn, the Oathbearer carries the weight of ancient vows in every step. Its ceremonial armor gleams with etched creeds, each a silent reminder of past allegiances and enduring pacts. Once a sacred mount of oath-sworn knights and high temple guards, it remains steadfast long after banners have fallen. The Oathbearer does not startle, does not flee, and does not falter, so long as its rider bears their purpose with honor.

6064633895661469726.title: Cosmetic: Flame Phoenix

6064633895711277119.title: Cosmetic: Peak Hound Pup

6064633895740506189.title: Mount Cosmetic: Steed of the Frayed Copse
6064633895740506189.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Born of twisted roots and old magic, the Steed of the Frayed Copse is a creature shaped more by rumor than nature. Its gnarled form crackles with residual enchantment, and those who ride it claim the forest itself watches through its eyes. It moves with eerie grace, carrying its rider through shadowed glades and forgotten paths.

6064633895762460758.title: Cosmetic: Redoubtable Ram
6064633895762460758.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895782056036.title: Cosmetic: Ruined Gargoyle

6064633895829373059.title: Mount Cosmetic: Mature Drill Spider
6064633895829373059.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Burly and relentless, the Mature Drill Spider is more machine than beast. Its rotating mandibles and chisel-like legs allow it to burrow through rock and ruin alike. As a mount, it?s favored by deep-dwellers and siege engineers, though few can stomach the grinding din or the constant vibration underfoot. Still, for those who can, there are few creatures better suited for the subterranean path.

6064633900551766062.title: Ironhearth Faultreaver
6064633900551766062.description: Forged along a trembling seam where molten iron met shattered bedrock, the Ironhearth Faultreaver hums with pressure held in check. Its strikes leave tremors in the wrist, and old stone paths sometimes crack beneath its weight, whether swung or not.

6064633900556156988.title: Sunfire Stonebind Great Axe
6064633900556156988.description: A soft aureate wash gathers at the beard, the color of first light crossing stone.

6064633900615467092.title: Nightreaver Gloamedge Rapier
6064633900615467092.description: A dim, liquid sheen rides the steel and vanishes when the light looks twice.

6064633900616777817.title: Seabright Sprayline Rapier
6064633900616777817.description: Light beads and scatters along the edge like seafoam in a crosswind.

6064633900618547295.title: Sunscorch Emberglass Rapier
6064633900618547295.description: A glassy warmth pools beneath the finish and holds without flare.

6064633900648300648.title: Coralblade Great Maelstrom-Mace
6064633900648300648.description: Shaped in the quiet eye of a sunken vortex, this weapon hums with weighty intent. Each swing leaves the scent of brine and the memory of pressure crushing from all sides.

6064633900678316168.title: Brooksteel Riverpoint
6064633900678316168.description: The Brooksteel Riverpoint leans gently toward flowing water and grows cool near stormclouds. When thrust, it parts mist like silk and leaves no wake in still pools.

6064633900684935315.title: Mirageborn Veilstroke Spear
6064633900684935315.description: The air around it seems to ripple, hiding the truth of its next motion.

6064633900690243737.title: Verdant Oath Bloomspire
6064633900690243737.description: The Verdant Oath Bloomspire releases a faint burst of pollen with every strike. When stilled in soil, its shaft greens and its tip leans gently toward sunrise, even in darkness.

6064633900693913757.title: Shadowfang Gloomfang Spear
6064633900693913757.description: A dark sheen clings to the blade, as if night itself refuses to let it go.

6064633900729368769.title: Deepweld Hollowforge Greatsword
6064633900729368769.description: Within its steel glimmers a second blade, as though another were imprisoned inside. A low resonance hums through the hilt when gripped.

6064633900738871496.title: Dreadwake Abyssal Sword
6064633900738871496.description: Its steel catches light like water disturbed, hiding depths the eye cannot follow.

6064633900800606440.title: Ironhearth Emberbrand
6064633900800606440.description: The Ironhearth Emberbrand glows faintly at the edge when battle nears and leaves behind a trace of heat in the air. Stone scorches where it lands, though the blade never blackens.

6064633900824854777.title: Mistwood Moonreaver
6064633900824854777.description: The Mistwood Moonreaver gleams only under moonlight and blurs at the edge when swung. It passes through fog like breath and leaves dew trailing from its arc.

6064633900901269805.title: Seabright Tideshaper Focus

6064633900910838074.title: Shadowfang Gloomfang Sword
6064633900910838074.description: A muted black luster coats the steel, drinking the light that dares touch it.

6064633900911165755.title: Shadowfang Gloomfang Greatsword
6064633900911165755.description: A haze clings to the steel as though it has passed through midnight unscathed. The scent of cold stone follows it.

6064633900911558972.title: Shadowfang Gloomfang Wand
6064633900911558972.description: A haze clings close, swallowing what little light approaches. A sharp chill follows it.

6064633900926173504.title: Stoneforge Linebow
6064633900926173504.description: The Stoneforge Linebow draws with the weight of intent and lands truer the longer it waits. Dust gathers in a perfect line from bow to target, even before the arrow is loosed.

6064633900936200524.title: Stormcurrent Tidefang Wand
6064633900936200524.description: Lightning glimmers within the grain, restless and bright. The taste of rain lingers after it moves.

6064634325298708480.title: Dawnbreaker
6064634325298708480.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Cloaked in shimmerwoven aether and kissed by the first light of the celestial dawn, the Mayoral Dawnbreaker of New Aela is no ordinary flying mount. Its form, a sublime fusion of ancient magic and primal grace, defies natural order: the musculature of a great owlbear, the ringed tail of a dusk-born rakari, and the multicolored, translucent wings of a butterfly. It is a living sigil of authority, arcana, and awe.

6064634325304868867.title: Wyrmling
6064634325304868867.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Clad in bronze scales that shimmer like sunlit armor, the Wyrmling is the ember-born offspring of a militant legacy. Though small in stature, it carries the spirit of an ancient fire, coiled tight within a frame still learning its place in the skies. Its breath is smoke and promise, its eyes twin coals that burn with challenge and curiosity. Tempered by flame and ferocity, it yields to no hand that has not earned its trust through trial. Once bound, however, its loyalty is fierce and unshakable, a bond forged not by dominance, but by mutual will. The Mayor of Halcyon holds that bond, rising into the storm-laced heavens astride a creature that may yet grow into legend.

6064634618931707981.description: Novice weavers will stain it with dye and fray it on spindle edges--but their first tunic will accept each mark with alacrity, as another step in their journey to ultimate mastery of the craft.

6064634674857639951.title: Pinion of the Hammer

6064634737443274767.title: The pendant is a small, swirling disk of iridescent metal that glints like heat shimmer. A stylized djinn shape is etched across its face, all curling lines and drifting smoke. It feels faintly warm to the touch.

6064634744581914946.title: Crude Lumberjacking Axe
6064634744581914946.description: Chopping adolescent trees causes more durability loss.
more: The head is forged from iron kissed with charcoal ash, and the haft is sanded smooth by a hundred nervous palms. It swings straighter than it should. That's how you know it's yours.

6064634762016784464.title: Grigg's Gig Stick
6064634762016784464.description: A poacher?s spear turned relic, scored with crude charms and tally marks of shadowed trails. It prefers ambush over honor, and seems eager for sudden choices, breath held, in the dark, out of sight, always.

6064634762075176967.title: Shatterbelt Warden Paildrons
6064634762075176967.description: Recovered from a mine captain buried in collapse, these pauldrons carry the hush of deep tunnels. Their runes speak of duty to hold the line when air thins and lamps die. Wearing them feels like bracing a failing ceiling with your own will.

6064634762101194827.title: Frostchain Mirewalkers
6064634762101194827.description: Light boots pulled from the cistern bridge, their stitching salted by lingering cold and old tunnel hymns. They make slick stone feel familiar, turning treacherous footing into a practiced dance across forgotten water ways.
